description: This file defines a sealed partial class 'ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor' that implements 'IClusterConnectionStatusObserver'. It manages cluster connection status notifications, including handling cluster connection loss and gateway count changes, and logs errors during these notifications.

classes.name: ClusterConnectionStatusObserverAdaptor
classes.description: A class that observes and reports changes in cluster connection status, including connection loss and gateway count changes, with integrated logging for error handling.

methods.name: NotifyClusterConnectionLost
methods.description: Notifies all registered handlers that the cluster connection has been lost, with error handling and logging.

methods.name: NotifyGatewayCountChanged
methods.description: Notifies all registered handlers of a change in the gateway count, with error handling and logging.
